name: Fairmont Le Chateau Frontenac
positioning: Hotel within the walls of Old Québec, a UNESCO World Heritage site, at the edge of the Dufferin Terrace (official name Fairmont Le Château Frontenac)
best_for: Travelers who want a base inside the walls of Old Québec
Families wanting a room with a living room and sofabed

facts.text: The hotel is located within the walls of Old Québec, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
The hotel sits at the edge of the Dufferin Terrace.
The hotel has four restaurants and bars.
Champlain is a restaurant with a tasting menu, and tables are not always easy to get, so booking ahead is advised.
Afternoon tea is served at Place Dufferin on weekends.
Fairmont Gold guests have access to a lounge with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes, and a private check-in and check-out on the 14th floor.
The Signature Two Double room has a living room with a sofabed and is described as ideal for families and long-stay guests.
The hotel has a spa called Moment Spa Le Château Frontenac.
The hotel also has a jacuzzi, a hammam and a sauna.
The hotel has a concierge team in the main lobby that can arrange city tours, limousine transportation or restaurant reservations.

highlights.text: Bar 1608, next to Champlain, is designed to look like a clock paused in time.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool with a view of Old Quebec.
An outdoor terrace just beyond the pool has a small bar and lounge chairs overlooking Old Quebec.

considerations.text: Valet parking is available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have smaller room sizes.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Le Château Frontenac
